description: This file defines the 'ExistentEntry' class, an immutable generic class representing a cache entry with a revision number and a value, used within a caching mechanism in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ExistentEntry
classes.description: An immutable class representing a cache entry with a revision number and a value.

methods.name: ExistentEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing revision and value fields.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number associated with this entry.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Indicates that this entry exists; always returns true.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on revision and value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on revision and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entry, including revision and value.
